description: 1. Agent reads /workspace/tools/mcp_config.json to discover the local mock MCP endpoint (http://localhost:7771/amazon_keyword_research). 2. Agent POSTs all 5 ASINs in a single call and receives per-ASIN keyword lists. 3. Agent deduplicates keywords across ASINs and counts overlap: 'resistance bands' (3 ASINs), 'resistance band set' (4), 'loop resistance bands' (4), 'physical therapy bands' (3) qualify as Tier 1 via the 3+ ASIN overlap rule; medium-volume/medium-competition keywords like 'exercise resistance bands', 'pull up assist bands', 'gym resistance bands' etc. are Tier 2; long-tail low-volume keywords are Tier 3. 4. 'nike shoes' and 'adidas running shoes' must be flagged as negative exact. 5. Agent creates exactly 4 ad groups: Tier1-Exact, Tier1-Phrase, Tier2-Phrase, Tier3-Broad — with Tier 2 keywords appearing in both Tier2-Phrase and Tier3-Broad. 6. Bids are computed as: Exact=$1.02 (0.85×1.2), Phrase=$0.85 (0.85×1.0), Broad=$0.60 (0.85×0.7). 7. File is written as a TAB-SEPARATED .txt with exactly the 23 prescribed column headers in the documented order. 8. Campaign row carries $40 daily budget; Ad Group rows carry the default bid; Keyword rows carry the match-type-specific bid in the 'Bid' column. 9. File saved to ~/Downloads/launchfast-ppc-bulk-20240801.txt.
